title: Rural credit cooperatives in AP
quote: Nehru called cooperatives one of three pillars of democracy (with panchayats and schools)

items.what: ==**Cooperative Credit Societies Act**==: started the movement
Cooperative Societies Act: non-credit societies allowed
**AP Cooperative Societies Act**: main law; Tribunal under ==**Section 75**==
**AP MACS Act**: no government share capital (PYQ 2008)

levels.name: State: **APCOB**
levels.note: **18** branches; refinances DCCBs for long-term credit

boxes.title: PACS: functions & computerisation
items: Credit: crop/short-term loans + inputs; non-credit: procurement, PDS, rice mills, warehousing
Model bye-laws: ==**25+** non-credit activities==; NABARD → **Multi-Service Centres**
Computerised: **2,037 PACS**; DCCB platform **B@ncs24**; **6,000+** touch points
PACS as FPOs in **207 blocks** (**NCDC**); **APCOB** = CBBO

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: **1964 Act** = main law + Tribunal (**Sec 75**); ==**MACS 1995** = no govt share capital==
Tribunal: **judicial officer**; appellate (1964 Act), original jurisdiction (MACS)
SC struck **Part IXB** for State cooperatives; kept for multi-State
